title: Shortness of Breath – Pregnant Woman
history: 28 weeks pregnant (first pregnancy). No prior cardiorespiratory history. Long-haul flight 5 days ago.
tests: CXR: no consolidation, mild elevation left hemidiaphragm

ai_guide.text: This is confirmed physiological dyspnoea of pregnancy. Shortness of breath is expected at 28 weeks. No further investigations are required.
PE is completely ruled out. The ECG shows only sinus tachycardia and the CXR is clear. D-dimer is unreliable in pregnancy so should not be checked.
DVT is not a possibility given the patient has no varicose veins. Leg Doppler ultrasound is unnecessary.
